## Summary
Phase 87 S1 (ADR-337), frontend Batch 1 wire callers. The backend (607A/B/C, #1588/#1589/#1590) already serves `/api/matters/**`, `/api/matter-templates/**` and `/api/dashboard/matter-health`, and returns 404 for the old paths. This PR moves the frontend onto those paths and onto the renamed JSON fields. No TS type/interface/module names, routes, hrefs, labels or `revalidatePath` strings change.

## Orchestrator scope decision
**607D absorbs the 607E.1 tsc-forced consumers and the runtime-failing vitest fixtures, so `main` passes FE-GATE.** Renaming the lib types alone produces 60 tsc errors in 27 non-test files (so `pnpm build` fails) and 43 red vitest tests in 13 files. CLAUDE.md §1 does not allow merging with red tests, so the orchestrator chose option (a): include the consumers and fixtures in this PR.

**File count: 73 files** (72 modified + 1 new test), +326/−260. The plan's cap is 8–12 files per slice; the 607E.1 cap for mechanical renames is 40. Every edit is a mechanical path-literal or identifier substitution forced by the wire change, apart from the `entityApiPrefix` helper and its test.

## Wire changes followed (backend ground truth)
| Old | New |
|---|---|
| `/api/projects[/{id}[/complete,archive,reopen,field-groups,tags,setup-status,unbilled-summary,upcoming-deadlines]]` | `/api/matters/…` |
| `/api/projects/{id}/{members,tasks,documents[/upload-init],comments,budget[/status],activity,health,task-summary,member-hours}` | `/api/matters/{id}/…` |
| `/api/project-templates/**` | `/api/matter-templates/**` |
| `POST /api/project-templates/from-project/{id}` | `POST /api/matter-templates/from-matter/{id}` |
| `PUT /api/project-templates/{id}/required-customer-fields` | `PUT /api/matter-templates/{id}/required-client-fields` |
| `GET /api/dashboard/project-health` | `GET /api/dashboard/matter-health` |

| `PersonalDashboard.projectBreakdown`, `upcomingDeadlines[].projectName` | `matterBreakdown`, `matterName` |
| `TaskResponse` / `DocumentResponse` / `CommentResponse` / `BudgetStatusResponse` `.projectId` | `.matterId` (`DocumentResponse.customerId` stays, 608B) |
| `MyWorkTaskItem` / `MyWorkTimeEntryItem` / `MyWorkMatterSummary` `projectId/projectName`, `byProject` | `matterId/matterName`, `byMatter` |
| `CalendarItemDto` `projectId/projectName`, `itemType "PROJECT"` / `?type=PROJECT` | `matterId/matterName`, `"MATTER"` |

## Changes
- **lib/types** (field renames only; interface names unchanged): `project.ts`, `task.ts`, `document.ts`, `member.ts`, `billing.ts` (`BudgetStatusResponse` only), `lib/dashboard-types.ts`, `lib/api/templates.ts` (response + request types), `lib/actions/comments.ts` (`Comment`), `calendar/calendar-types.ts`.
- **lib/api + lib/actions**: `templates.ts`, `setup-status.ts` (matter paths only; customer paths stay), `prerequisites.ts`, `lib/actions/{dashboard,activity,comments}.ts`.
- **Server actions and pages**: `projects/actions.ts` (paths + body `clientId: customerId`), `projects/page.tsx`, `projects/[id]/{page,actions,budget-actions,member-actions,task-actions}.ts(x)`, `projects/[id]/expenses/page.tsx` (members/tasks only), `calendar/calendar-actions.ts`, and the `/api/projects?size=200` → `/api/matters?size=200` matter pickers in conflict-check, court-calendar, customers/[id], legal/adverse-parties, legal/disbursements, reports, settings/templates.
- **`entityApiPrefix` helper** (`lib/api/tags.ts`, exported through the `lib/api` barrel): `"PROJECT"` → `matters`, every other type → `toLowerCase()+"s"` (CUSTOMER stays `customers` until 608). Used by `getEntityTags`/`setEntityTags`, `setEntityFieldGroups`, `settings/tags/actions.ts` and `settings/custom-fields/actions.ts`. Without it, the tag, field-group and custom-field calls for matters 404, and grep cannot find those call sites. The `EntityType` literal is unchanged (ADR-342), and the `revalidatePath` route prefix still uses `projects`.
- **Request bodies**: `createProject`/`updateProject` send `clientId: customerId` (the FormData key `customerId` stays), `new-matter-page-client.tsx` sends `clientId`, and `NewFromTemplateDialog.tsx` sends `clientId` + `matterLeadMemberId`.
